description: Perennial, tuberous-rhizomatous herb to ca. 15 cm tall; glabrous except for microscopic glandular trichomes and bristle-pointed teeth of the leaf margin, or with sparse indumentum of white hairs up to ca. 1 mm long on adaxial leaf lamina veins and upper petioles. Stem composed of multiple tuberous units, each up to 3 × 1.1 cm, leaves and inflorescences arising from very short stems (to 5 mm long) from the tuberous units, glabrous. Leaves alternate; stipules persistent, ca. 5‒15 × 2‒4 mm, narrowly obovate, with an abaxially prominent midrib, apex narrowed into bristle up to 2 mm long, glabrous; petioles 4.8–10.5 cm long, glabrous or sometimes sparsely hairy in apical part, red or pale green; lamina basifixed, 5–13 × 3–10.4 cm, ovate, asymmetrical to symmetrical, base cordate, basal lobes not overlapping, apex acute to shortly acuminate, margin denticulate, serrulate, to distantly dentate, teeth bristle-pointed, adaxial surface dark green, sometimes variegated with rows of white spots, abaxial surface pale green to reddish, glabrous or with sparse indumentum on the veins; venation palmate-pinnate, primary veins 5–6, actinodromous, secondary veins craspedodromous. Inflorescences: protogynous; female flowers solitary, peduncle 1‒2 mm long, glabrous, bracts semi-persistent, 4−11 × 1.5−7 mm, elliptic, glabrescent; male inflorescences racemose-cymose composed of 2‒10 subumbellate partial inflorescences, each a compressed monochasium with 3‒5 flowers, peduncle of male partial inflorescence 6−36 mm long, hairy, bracts persistent, to 7−10 × 1.8−2 mm at the base of the inflorescence, narrowly ovate, abaxially hairy. Male flowers: pedicels 8–28 mm long, glabrous; tepals 2, white or pale pink, 8–11 × 11–12 mm, broadly ovate, base slightly cordate or convex, apex rounded, glabrous; androecium of ca. 20‒40 stamens, yellow, filaments ca. 0.5−1 mm long, fused into a short but distinct column up to ca. 1 mm long at the base, anthers ca. 0.8−1.2 mm long, obovate or elliptic, dehiscing through unilaterally positioned slits that are < ½ as long as the anthers. Female flowers: pedicels 13−33 mm long, glabrous; tepals 5, white or pink, unequal to subequal, larger 11–14 × 7–9 mm, ovate to elliptic, smallest one 9−11 × 4−6 mm, obovate or narrowly elliptic, outer surface glabrous; ovary 5–10 × 5–8 mm (excluding the wings), elliptic, wings 3, equal, base rounded to cuneate, apex truncate, subtruncate, cuneate or convex, widest point up to 7 mm (middle to subapically), glabrous, locules 3, placentation axile, placentae bilamellate; style up to ca. 4.5 mm long, basally fused, 3–branched, each stylodium bifurcate in the stigmatic region, stigmatic surface a spirally twisted papillose band, stylodia yellowish, stigma orange. Fruit: dry capsule; peduncles to 2 mm long; pedicels to 45 mm long, glabrous to hairy; seed-bearing part 8−10 × 5−8 mm (excluding the wings), ellipsoid, wing shape as for ovary, glabrous. Seeds barrel-shaped, ca. 0.2−0.3 mm long.

description: Monoecious perennial rhizomatous herbs. Rhizome dark green to maroon to brown, 4 to 16 cm long, 10–16 mm thick, subglabrous, internodes 4–8 mm long. Stipules ovate, green to pink to brown, apex aristate, 7–19 × 5–14 mm, with prominent pink to red keel and with tuft of pink hairs (6–10 mm long) on the abaxial side. Leaves alternate; petiole, green to maroon to brown, terete, 12–26 cm long and 4–8 mm thick, tomentose (0.5–2.0 mm green to brown hairs); blade mostly obliquely rounded some obliquely wide ovate, 8–11 × 8–12 cm, adaxial lamina dark green to maroon, glabrous, abaxial lamina light green to maroon with prominently raised veins, pilose with light green to maroon hispid (0.5–1 mm long), denser on the veins, margin shallowly undulate almost entire, ciliate; base cordate, lobes rounded, apex obliquely rounded to slightly acute, venation palmate, primary veins 9–10. Inflorescence axillary, arising directly from the rhizome, dichotomously branched ca. five times; peduncle light green to maroon to brown 10–25 cm long and 2–5 mm thick, erect, with white to green to brown glandular hairs (0.5–2 mm) varying from sparse to dense. Bracts boat-shaped, pink to maroon 4–5 × 5–6 mm, with white to green to brown glandular hairs (0.5–1 mm), bracteoles pink to maroon, densely covered with glandular hairs, boat-shaped, 2.5–4 × 4–5 mm in staminate flower and ovate, 2–2.5 × 3–4 mm in pistillate flower. Staminate flower: pedicel light green to maroon, erect to ascending, 3–18 mm with pinkish to green glandular hairs (0.5–1 mm) varying from sparse to dense; corolla 15–20 × 12–18 mm; tepals 2+2, white, glabrous, outer pair orbicular to oblong 7–9 × 7–8 mm, inner pair oblanceolate 5–8 × 2–3 mm, adaxial side of both outer and inner tepals white, while abaxial side pinkish, androecium actinomorphic, stamens 25–30, filaments 1 mm long, shortly united at the base; anthers yellow, oblong, 1 mm long. Pistillate flower: pedicel green to pink, ascending at the beginning then later recurving downwards, 9–10 mm with pinkish to green glandular hairs (0.5–1 mm), varying from sparse to dense; corolla 14–16 × 13–15 mm; tepals 2+3, outer pair orbicular 6–7 × 6–7 mm; pinkish abaxial and white adaxial, 3 inner tepals white, asymmetrical, 6–9 × 2–5 mm; ovary pinkish green, oblong 4–7 × 3–4 mm (wings excluded), wings 3, unequal, 6–10 mm long, lateral wings, narrowly crescent-shaped, 3–6 mm wide, abaxial wing much protruded, crescent-shaped, acute or rounded at proximal, truncate at distal, 8–14 mm wide, ovary and wings with pinkish glandular hairs (0.5–1 mm), tri-locular, placentae axile, bifid; styles three, 2–4 mm long, stigma yellow, spirally twisted and papillose all around. Capsule pendent, glabrous, recurved such that the largest wing is facing downwards, 6–12 × 14–22 mm, obliquely rounded to sub-rhomboid in outline.
contributor: Rubite R.R. et al.

description: Prostrate, rhizomatous, rupicolous, occasionally epiphytic, herbs, 9–13 cm tall (excluding the inflorescence), squamulose, with 2-branched trichomes and fimbriate scales. Cystoliths absent. Stem prostrate, internodes ca. 0.5 cm long, lenticellate, reddish in their proximal regions, greenish distally, with 2-branched trichomes. Stipules persistent, 5–10 × 5–9 mm, ovate to broadly ovate, apex acute, margins ciliate, pubescent on dorsal surface to densely pilose at the base and along the principal veins, with simple trichomes and 2-branched trichomes, reddish. Leaves simple, petioles 5.5–11 cm long, cylindrical, lenticellate, reddish, densely squamulose along their entire length, scales fimbriate, hairs whitish, leaf blades basifixed, 6–10 × 5.6–6 cm, entire, transversely ovate, asymmetrical, apex acute, base cordate, basal lobes rounded, overlapping the petiole, margins inconspicuously crenate, ciliate, undulate, fleshy, adaxial surface glabrous, dark green, shiny to slightly light green on the veins, abaxial surface puberulent, minutely pubescent, with 2-branched trichomes and fimbriate scales on the principal veins, vinaceous to light green on the veins, venation actinodromous, veins 8–10. Inflorescence in 4–5-branched cymes, 12–18 cm long (including the rachis), rachis (6–7.5) 11–11.5 cm (up to ca. 28 cm long when fruiting), pubescent, simple trichomes, greenish to reddish. Bracts caducous, ca. 6 × 2 mm, lanceolate, apex aristate, margin entire, in upper part of the dorsal surface sparsely pilose, vinaceous. Male flower: pedicels 9–14 mm long, pilose with simple trichomes, hairs reddish, and with sparsely distributed microscopic glandular trichomes, greenish to white, tepals 4, external pair white on basal portions to pinkish distally, 8–12 × 8–13 mm, broadly ovate, apex rounded, margins ciliate, membranaceous, glabrous on the dorsal basal surface and pilose in the upper third, near the margins, simple trichomes, hairs reddish, 0.5–1 mm long, internal pair white, 6–10 × 2–4 mm, obovate to oblanceolate, apex obtuse, base acute, margins entire to revolute, glabrous, stamens 10–12, 2–3 mm long, filaments 0.5–1 mm long, free, anthers 1.5–2.3 mm long (including connective), oblong, latrorse, yellow. Female flower: pedicels white, 10–11 mm long, with sparsely distributed microscopic glandular trichomes, bracteole absent, tepals 5, white to pinkish, unequal, 4 largest ones 8–11 × 6–9 mm, ovate, widely ovate to widely obovate, apex acute, the smallest one ca. 7–10 × 5–7 mm, ovate to obovate, apex acute, margin ciliate, inconspicuously serrulate at apex, membranaceous, glabrous on the dorsal basal surface and puberulous in the upper third, near the margins, simple trichomes, hairs reddish, ca. 0.5 mm long, ovary pinkish, 3-locular, ca. 8–9 ×13 mm, with sparsely distributed glandular trichomes and with a single trichome at the base of ovary, margins of wings with 1–3 trichomes, placentae entire, stigmas 3, ca. 2 mm long, bifurcate, branches spiraled, with stigmatic papillae distributed along the branches, yellow. Capsule ca. 29 × 27 mm (including the wings), transversely oblate, dehiscent on basal portion, glabrous, except by being pilose near the peduncles, pinkish when fresh, light brown when mature, peduncles 15–17 cm long, puberulous, pinkish, wings 3, unequal, the largest one 10–12 mm wide, the smallest one 5–6 mm wide, locular region 11–12 × 6 mm, elliptic, margins with trichomes, seeds oblong.
contributor: Miranda M.D. & Jacques E.d.L.

description: Lithophytic herb with a stoloniferous stem. Indumentum of soft hyaline hairs, erect, unbranched, 0.3–1.4 mm long, very dense on stems, petioles and leaves, glandular hairs ca. 0.15 mm long, dense on peduncle, rachis, pedicel, ovary and fruit, but sparse on outer tepals. Tubers form at nodes of stems, globose to cylindrical, 2.5–7 × 2–4.5 mm, surface densely covered with golden brown hairs, hairs flagelliform and scale-like, scale-like hairs thin flat, irregular star-shaped, 1.0–1.3(–1.8) × 1.0–1.3(–1.7) mm, lobes irregular, fitting together in layers, fibrous roots 0.5–1.8 cm long, cream to yellow brown, newly formed tubers pale green-yellow. Stems creeping and unbranched with nodes forming tubers and roots, or prostrate with erect branches, ca. 1 mm thick, notably slender, red to deep purplered; stipules 2 to 3 per node, recurved, triangular, 1–1.5 × 0.5 mm, margins incised and translucent, tip acute, pale green tinged red to vivid red, deep red midrib, caduceus. Leaves opposite, 3 to 4 blades whorled and sometimes alternate at erect stems; petiole terete, 1.4–1.8 cm long, ca. 0.6 mm across, red to deep purple-red; blades thinly succulent, less than 0.5 mm thick (ca. 0.3 mm), orbicular or broadly ovate, not oblique, symmetrical, 0.9–1.2(–1.8) × 0.9–1.2(–1.9) cm, base cordate, overlapping when mature, margin crenate or shallowly dentate, apex rounded or obtuse, surfaces flat, deep bluish green to dark yellowish green, or variegated with white spots, beneath deep purplish red, thin papery translucentwhen dried; veins palmate, beneath prominent towards base, lateral veins 3–4 pairs. Inflorescence terminal, erect, ca. 5 cm long, generally monochasial, rarely dichasial, peduncle ca. 35 mm long, diameter ca. 0.8 mm, main branches 2, male flowers 1 or 2 or 4, female flowers 1 or 2, pedicels 3–6 mm; bracts and bracteoles 2–3, elliptic-lanceolate, boatshaped or recurved, 1.5–2 × 0.5–0.6 mm, outer surface with scattered short glandular hairs, midrib minutely prominent, margins minutely incised and translucent, apex acute, pale green tinged red to vivid red, persistent. Male flowers with 4–5 tepals, margin entire, 3–4.5 × 2–3.5 mm, pale pink to dark pink, darker towards both base and apex; outer tepals 2, ovate, shallow concave, apex obtuse or rounded, 3–4.5 × 2.5–3.5 mm; inner tepals 2, obovate, apex rounded, 4–4.5 × 2–2.5 mm; stamens 8–18, torus 1–1.2 mm long, stamen mass globose sometimes ovoid, symmetric, 1.5–2 mm across; anthers broadly obovoid, ca. 0.4–0.6 × 0.35–0.5 mm, tip slightly emarginated, tip and outer surface papillate, bright yellow with a hint of green, dehiscing through 2 longitudinal slits on inner surface, slits strong pale yellow. Female flowers with 4–5 tepals, margin entire, 4.5–5 × 2.5–3.5 mm, broadly lanceolate to obovate, pale yellow-green ovary with red veins, 3–4 × 2.5–3.5 mm, wings 3 unequal, locules 2; styles and stigmas, ca. 1.5 mm long, style pale yellow or light pink, stigma 2(–4), C-shaped with coiled ends, papillose, yellow. Capsules a pendent splash cup, ca. 4 × 7.8 mm, covered with glandular hairs ca. 0.15 mm long, pale yellow-green to light brownish green with red veins, locules 2, placentas 2 branches per locule, splitting longitudinally between locules; wings 3 unequal, longer wing 3 × 6 mm, oblong obtuse, shorter wings ca. 1 mm wide, style caduceus after tepals have fallen. Seeds numerous, barrel-shaped, ca. 0.3 × 0.2 mm, surface sculptured
contributor: Tan J.P.C., Fathmath S.F. & Tam S.M.

description: Lithophytic herb with a stoloniferous stem. Stems, petioles and leaves, outer tepals, ovary and fruit glabrous, but sometimes with sparse minute glandular hairs on the peduncle, rachis and pedicel ca. 0.07 mm long. Tuber globose, irregular globose or cylindrical, 5–10 × 4–5 mm, surface densely covered a layer of golden brown hairs, 1–1.5 mm thick, hairs flagelliform and scale-like, thin undulate, longer than wide irregular shape, (1.5–)1.6(–2.3) × 1.1–1.3 mm, irregular lobes slender, often with lateral lobes, disorderly fits together. Stems creeping and unbranched with nodes forming tubers and roots, or prostrate with erect branches, ca. 1 mm thick, notably slender, vivid orangered; stipules 2 per node, porrect, triangular, 2 × 1.5 mm, margins incised, tip acute, brownish red, caduceus. Leaves opposite, 3 to 4 blades whorled or sometimes alternate on erect stems; petiole terete, 0.7–1.1 cm long, ca. 0.6 mm across, vivid orange-red; blades firm succulent, ca. 0.5 mm thick, orbicular, not oblique, symmetrical, (0.9–)1.0(–1.6) × (0.9–)1.0(–1.5) cm, base cordate, not overlapping, margin crenate, apex rounded, surface flat between the veins, very light yellow-green tinged pink or bright orange-pink or dull brownish pink to fully dark pink, beneath deep orange-red, thin leathery when dried; veins palmate, impressed above, beneath minutely prominent towards base, lateral veins 3–4 pairs. Inflorescence terminal, erect, ca. 4 cm long, generally monochasial, rarely dichasial, peduncle ca. 26 mm long, diameter ca. 0.6 mm, branches 2, male flowers 1 or 2, female flowers 1 or 2, pedicels 3–4 mm; bracts in pairs at main branches, bracteoles in pairs at base of pedicel, lanceolate, boat-shaped, 2.0–2.5 × 1.0 mm, glabrous, margin usually entire or rarely minutely serrulate, apex obtuse, pale green tinged red to vivid orange-red, caduceus. Male flowers with 4 tepals, margin entire, 3–6 × 2–4.5 mm, light pink to pink, darker colour towards both base and apex; outer tepals 2, ovate, shallow concave, apex obtuse or rounded, 3.5–5.0× 3.0–4.0; inner tepals 2, obovate, apex rounded, 4–4.5 × 2–3 mm; stamens 12–20, torus ca. 0.5 mm long, stamen mass globose, symmetric, ca. 1.3 mm across; anthers broadly obovoid, ca. 0.5–0.6 × 0.5–0.6 mm, tip minutely emarginated, tip and outer surface papillate, bright yellow with a hint of green, dehiscing through 2 longitudinal slits on inner surface, longitudinal slits strong pale yellow. Female flowers with 4–5 tepals, margin entire, lanceolate to obovate, 5–6.5 × 3– 3.5 mm, with a light to vivid pink ovary in dark pink margins, ca. 3.0 × 4.5 mm, wings 3 unequal, locules 2; styles 2, ca. 1.5 mm long, pale yellow or light pink, stigmas Cshaped with coiled ends, papillose, yellow. Capsules a pendent splash cup, 4–6 × 5–8 mm, glabrous, vivid red, locules 2, placentas 2 branches per locule, splitting longitudinally between locules; wings 3 unequal, longer wing ca. 4 × 6 mm, oblong rounded, shorter wings ca. 1 mm wide, style caduceus after tepals have fallen. Seeds numerous, barrel-shaped, 0.18–0.25 × 0.13–0.15 mm, surface sculptured.

description: A lithophytic, monoecious, rhizomatous herb. Rhizome greenish brown, sparse red hirsute, creeping, to ca. 7.3 mm in diameter, internodes to ca. 11.6 mm. Stipules triangular, ca. 8 mm long, 3 mm wide, persistent, hyaline, pale red, keeled, margins entire, apex aristate, arista to ca. 1 cm long, keel, base and margins fringed with fleshy aristate trichomes 1–6 mm long, trichomes occasionally branching. Petiole terete, orange to pale red, to ca. 18 cm long and ca. 3.5 mm in diameter, pilose, with numerous brown trichomes 2–3 mm long. Leaves ca. 11, alternate; lamina basifixed, asymmetric, long ovate, rugose, 12–18 cm long × 4.5–9 cm wide, adaxial surface glabrous, glossy, olive green with occasional white patches at inter-vein spaces, abaxial surface pale maroon, primary veins with minutely appressed maroon trichomes ca. 1 mm long, mid-vein glabrous; venation palmate, base cordate, lobes rounded, sinus sometimes slightly or not overlapping, apex long acuminate, margins shallowly undulate, irregularly serrated, ciliate with pale red trichomes ca. 2 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, paniculate, protandrous, cymosely branching up to 5 times, to ca. 30 cm long, peduncle ca. 23 cm long, indumentum sparse, appressed pilose with brown trichomes 1–1.5 mm long. Bracts green, hyaline, boat-shaped, elliptic, caducous, glabrous, apex bluntly obtuse, ca. 9 mm long × 5 mm wide; bracteoles green, widely ovate, boat-shape, caducous, margin entire, ca. 6 mm long × 4 mm wide. Staminate flower pedicel pinkish green, glabrous, ca. 7 mm long; tepals 4, white, glabrous, outer tepals widely ovate, apex obtusely rounded, ca. 8 mm long × 9 mm wide, inner tepals oblong to obovate, apex slightly retuse, ca. 8 mm long × 4 mm wide; androecium actinomorphic, ca. 4 mm across; stamens 35–40, ca. 3 mm long, filaments shortly fused at base, 1.5–2 mm long, yellow, anthers basifixed, elliptic, apex rounded, dehiscing unilaterally along the length, ca. 1 mm long. Pistillate flower pedicel greenish brown, glabrous, ca. 11 mm long; tepals 4, pale pink, outer tepals orbicular to broadly ovate, apex rounded, ca. 5 mm long × 6 mm wide, inner tepals elliptic to ovate, apex rounded, ca. 5 mm long × 3 mm wide; ovary glabrous, green, trigonous-ellipsoid, 8–9 mm long, ca. 4 mm thick (wings excluded); 3-winged, wings subequal, lunate, margins round to slightly triangular, 8–9 mm long × 3–6 mm wide, locules 3, placentae bilaminate; styles 3, ca. 2 mm long, shortly fused at base, stigma greenish-yellow, ca. 1 mm long, spirally twisted and papillose all around. Fruit pedicel 5–6 mm long, tepals deciduous, glabrous, recurved, 11–13 mm long × 15–18 mm wide, dehiscing along the attachment of the wings, wings 3, subequal, 11–13 mm long × 6–8 mm wide.

description: Perenial monoecious herb, up to 10 cm tall. Stem rhizomatous, light green with few white spots, sparsely hairy at the joint of stem and petiole, thickened and brown in older stems, rooting at the nodes, diameter 3–5 mm, internodes compressed 3 –8 mm. Leaves alternate; stipules persistent, ovate, 8–10 × 7–9 mm, pale green, asymmetric, midrib abaxially prominent, hairy along the midrib to the apex extension, apex narrowed and extended up to 2 cm long; petioles 3–9.5 cm long, reddish brown, terete, with long white pilose hairs, up to 4 mm long; lamina basifixed, broadly ovate, 4–7 × 6–9 cm, asymmetric, reniform, margin crenate, ciliate with recurved stiff teeth at the end of the veins, base cordate, rarely overlapped, apex mostly rounded, rarely shortly acute, adaxially light green on the veins and the leaf base, dark purple patches between the veins and light green blotches, glabrous, bullate, abaxially paler, sparsely hairs along the veins; venation palmate, primary veins 6–7, actinodromous, secondary craspedrodomous. Inflorescences bisexual, axillary, protandrous, cymes branching once dichasially at the base and at the two lateral branches branching monochasially, with up to 4 male flowers and one female at the apex, peduncle 7–13 cm long, pale green, sparsely hairy; bracts persistent, elliptic, ca. 3 × 2 mm, margin fringed, bracteoles minute, hairlike. Male flowers: pedicels 12–22 mm long, white, glabrous to sparsely hairy; tepals 4, unequal, 2 outer tepals elliptic to obovate, ca. 8‒13 × 8–10 mm, margin entire, apex acute to rounded, white tinged pink, abaxially surface glabrescent; 2 inner tepals spatulate, 5–12 × 3–4.5 mm, margin entire, apex rounded; androecium globose, yellow; stamens 46–50, outer anthers subsessile, inner anthers on filaments about the same length as the anther, anthers 0.50 mm long, obtriangular, apex retuse, dehiscing through lateral slits about half the length of the anther. Female flowers: pedicel 8–18 mm long, pale green, glabrous; tepals 2–3, unequal, white or white tinged with pink, 2 outer tepals elliptic, 4‒12 × 7‒8.5 mm, margin entire, apex rounded, inner tepal(s) narrowly obovate, 4‒ 5 × 1‒2 mm margin entire, apex rounded; ovary (excluding wings) ovoid to ellipsoid, ca. 8 × 5‒6 mm, reddish, glabrous, locules 3, placentation axile, placentae entire, total size including the wings ca. 12 × 11 mm, capsule three locular, placentae entire; wings 3, equal to subequal, base truncate to cuneate, apex cuneate, widest point at the middle part up to ca. 6 mm long; stigmas 3, yellow, Y-shaped, ca. 4 mm long, surface once spirally twisted. Fruit: pendent on a thin 10–20 mm long pedicels, recurved, seed bearing part ovoid to ellipsoid, ca. 8.5 × 6.5 mm, tip beaked, wings shape as for ovary, widest point up to 6 mm long (middle part). Seeds unknown.
contributor: Ardi W.H., Girmansyah D. & Hughes M.
