description: Monoecious acaulescent herb, 4–7 cm tall. Stems succulent, erect, dark red, terete, tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 4−5 mm diam. Leaves 3–5, arising from tuber or basal of short aerial stem, lamina basifixed; petiole dark red basal, pale green above, brown when dry, 0.5−3 cm long, leaf blade succulent, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface echinate, dull dark green, glossy, abaxial surface glabrous, pale green or dark red on veins, ovate to oval, 5−20 by 5−10 mm, base cuneate, apex rounded and deeply sinuate, margin sinuate on half way of leaf blade, venation palmate, veins 4−5, prominent beneath. Stipules persistent, pale green, lanceolate, 1−2 by 0.5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, cyme, 1−2 times, bisexual, 4−7 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous, peduncles c. 3 cm long, terete, glabrous, dark red in basal half, then pale green, glossy. Bracts 1 pair, 3 by 1 mm. Staminate flowers: pedicels pale green, 3−5 mm, ascending, tepals 4, pale magenta, outer 2 orbicular, 3−4 by 2−3 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, outer parts sparsely echinate at middle, inside glabrous, inner 2 obcordate or obdeltate, 3−4 by 1−2 mm, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens 10, bright yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 1 mm long, anthers obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by short slits near tip. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale green, 4−6 mm long, tepals 5 (−7), pale magenta, sparsely echinate outside, subequal, outer 3 obovate, 3−5 by 1−2 mm, inner 3 oblanceolate or obdeltate, 3−5 by 2 mm, styles 3, fused at base, bright yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, minutely papillose, ovary pale green, 3-locular, with 3 subequal wings, placentae unilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, pendulous, glossy, pale green, drying pale brown, 5−6 by 6−7 mm with wings, locules ovate, 3−4 by 3−4 mm, abaxial wing irregular trigonous and curved along length of capsule, 4−5 mm long, c. 10 mm at base, 2 lateral wings narrower, curved along length of capsule, c. 3 mm tall 4−5 mm at base. description: Monoecious acaulescent herb, 20−100 cm tall. Stems rhizomatous, rhizome elongate, creeping, 1–3 times branching, glossy, dark red, 15−20 mm diam., with numerous fibrous roots. Leaves: petiole dark red, 20−90 cm long, lamina basifixed, succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface glabrous, dull dark green, abaxial surface sparsely hairy on veins, pale green, glossy; ovate, 14−25 by 7−30 cm, base cordate, apex acuminate, margin sinuate and ciliate or with 3 arching tip at the end of veins, venation palmate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 7−9 veins, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath. Stipules persistent, dark red, ovate, c. 5 by 10 mm, apex acute, margin ciliate. Inflorescences arising from rhizome, bisexual, 40−100 cm long, polychasium, branching 1–2 times with many staminate flowers and c. 14–16 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous, peduncle terete, densely hirsute, dark red, glossy, 25−70 cm long. Bracts caducous, leafy, ovate, apex obtuse, margin ciliate, pale green, glossy. Staminate flowers: pedicels pale pink, 10 mm long, tepals 4, pale pink, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 10 by 9 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin slightly crenate, outer parts hairy with glandular hairs, inner parts glabrous, inner 2 oblong, 10 by 4−5 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse or truncate, margin entire, outer parts hairy with glandular hairs, inner parts glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments nearly free, c. 3 mm long, anthers oblong, 1−1.5 mm long, dehiscing vertical by slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale pink, 10−20 mm long, tepals 4, pale pink, outer 2 orbicular, 10−12 by 10−12 mm, covered with glandular hairs on outer parts, inner 2 obovate, 8−10 by 4−5 mm, covered with glandular hairs on outer parts, styles 3, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary very hairy with 3 unequal wings, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, very hairy with glandular hairs when young, glabrous when mature, drying pale brown, 20−25 by 10−15 mm, locules ovate-oblong, 10 by 7 mm, abaxial wing triangular or crest-shaped, c. 10 mm long, c. 10 mm wide at base, 2 laterals narrower, crest−shaped curved along length capsule, 2−3 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious caulescent herb, 30 cm tall. Stipules persistent, greenish white or pale green or dark red with red striation, lanceolate, glabrous or hairy outside, apex acute, margin entire, 5−14 by 2−8 mm. Bracts persistent, membranous, ovate, 10−15 by 4−5 mm, dark red, pale green or whitish pink, glossy, apex obtuse, margin entire. Staminate flowers: pedicels 5−15 mm, erect (or occasionally ascending), tepals 4, plain white or white with red striation, outer 2 orbicular, 5−13 by 5−10 mm, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides; inner 2 ovate-lanceolate, 5−8 by 2−3 mm, base rounded, apex acute, margin entire, base cuneate, glabrous on both side, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments, fused at base, c. 0.5 mm long, anthers obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip. description: Monoecious rhizomatous herb. Rhizome elongate, creeping, glabrous, c. 30 cm long, c. 4−5 mm diam. Stipules persistent, ovate, 4−5 by 3−4 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences arising from rhizome, bisexual, ca. 15 cm long, polychasial, branching 1–2 times, protandrous; peduncle terete, 10−12 cm long. Bracts persistent, membranous, ovate, 3−4 by 1−2 mm, glabrous, apex obtuse, margin entire. Staminate flowers: pedicels 8−10 mm long, tepals 4, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, reddish, 4−5 by 4−6 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous, inner 2 oblanceolate, 15 by 3 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, filaments fused at base, c. 1 mm long, anthers oblong, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by longitudinal slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels 5−10 mm long, tepals 4, unequal, glabrous, outer 2 dark red, ovate, ca. 4−5 by 5−6 mm, inner 2, white, oblanceolate, 5 by 2 mm, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, once spirally twisted, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placenta one per locule. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, nodding, pendulous, drying pale brown, 20 by 10 mm, locules ovate, 15 by 5−6 mm, abaxial wing curve with rounded tip, 20 mm wide and 10 mm tall, lateral wings narrower, curved along length of capsule, 3−4 mm long. description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 5–20 cm tall. Stems succulent, glossy, erect or suberect, glabrous or sparsely or densely hairy, pale green or dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5−10 mm diam. Leaves 1−2(−4) per plant, basifixed; petiole pale green or dark red, reddish brown when dry, 2−10 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric or subsymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface sparsely or densely hairy, dull light or dark green or brown to black or mid green, glossy, iridescent, abaxial sparsely hairy on veins, pale green or dark red on veins; ovate, 3−25 by 4−15 cm, base cordate, apex acute, margin entire or sinuate or deeply sinuate with sparse hairs, venation palmate, veins 6−7. Stipules caducous, pale green, lanceolate, glabrous, apex acute, margin entire, 3−4 by 2−3 mm. Inflorescences terminal, 3−15 cm long, dichasial, bisexual, 1−4 times branched with many staminate flowers and 1–2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncles 2−10 cm long, terete, pale green or dark red, glossy, glabrous. Bracts persistent, membranous, pale green, glossy, ovate-lanceolate, 3−4 by 1−2 mm, apex obtuse, margin entire. Staminate flowers pedicels 5−10 mm, erect (or occasionally ascending), tepals 4, pinkish white or pale pink, outer 2 orbicular, 3−6 by 4−5 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 3−4 by 2−3 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, anthers obcordate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip, filaments fused at base. Pistillate flowers pedicels pale pink, 3−10 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, 4 ovate oblong, pale pink, 4−7 by 2−5 mm, 1 ovate, 2−5 by 1−2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 subequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, glossy, pale green, pendulous, drying pale brown, c. 8−15 by 5−10 mm, locules elliptic, 3−8 by 3−6 mm, abaxial wing oblong−triangular and sinuate, 10−18 mm long, lateral wings narrower, slightly deltate, curved along length of capsule, 3−5 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.5 mm long.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 10–25 cm tall. Stems succulent, glossy, erect or suberect, densely hairy, dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 4−10 mm diam. Leaves only 2−4(−5) per plant, lamina basifixed; petiole dark red, densely pilose, reddish brown when dry, 1.5−10(−15) cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric or subsymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface densely pilose, dull light or dark green or dull dark green with black or reddish brown variegated patches on veins, abaxial surface densely pilose, pale green or dark red on veins, ovate or orbicular, 2−11 by 3−10 cm, base cordate, apex rounded, margin crenate, ciliate, venation palmate, veins 5−7. Stipules persistent, dark red, lanceolate, 2−3 by 0.5−1 mm, hairy, apex acute, margin ciliate. Inflorescences terminal, cymose, bisexual, branched 1−2 times, 3−6 cm long, with 3−4 staminate flowers and 1 pistillate flower per branch, protandrous; peduncles terete, 3−6 cm long, whitish pink, glossy, densely pilose. Bracts caducous, membranous, lanceolate, 2−3 by 1 mm, pale green, densely pilose, apex obtuse, margin entire. Staminate flowers pedicels erect, whitish pink, 10−30 mm, tepals 4, plain white, outer 2 orbicular or obovate, 10−12 by 8−10 mm, base obtuse or cuneate, apex rounded, margin entire, outer parts densely pilose, inner parts glabrous, inner tepals absent or 2 narrowly oblong, 4−5 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, subglobose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments c. 1 mm long, fused at base; anthers obovate c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by longitudinal slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels greenish white, 10−20 mm long, tepals 2, plain white, ovate or orbicular, 8−10 by 9−10 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer part densely pilose, styles 3, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, dark yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary green with red striation, 3 subequal wings, densely pilose, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, pale green with red striation, drying pale brown, 10−12 by 10 mm, locules elliptic, 3 by 8 mm, wings 3, subequal, triangular, c. 5 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.4 mm.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 30−100 cm tall. Stems erect, dark red, terete; rhizome elongate, creeping, glossy, dark red, 10−15 mm in diam. with numerous fibrous roots. Leaves 3−6 per plant; petiole dark red, densely pilose, 20−30 cm long; lamina basifixed, succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface with dense short hairs, dull dark green, abaxial surface with densely short hairs on veins, pale green or dark red on veins, glossy, palmatifid, 15−30 by 17−24 cm, apex acuminate in each lobed base margin deeply lobed, cordate or sagittate, 7−9 lobed, venation palmate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 7−9 veins, slightly impressed above and prominent beneath. Stipules persistent, dark red, ovate-lanceolate, 10 by 5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences axillary, bisexual, 1–2 cm long, dichasial, branching 1–2 times with 8–10 staminate flowers and c. 2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncle, terete, 0.5−1 cm long, glossy, dark red, densely pilose. Bracts caducous, ovate-lanceolate, apex acute, margin entire, dark red, glossy. Staminate flowers: pedicels pale pink, 10−40 mm long, densely pilose, tepals 4, plain white, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 10−12 by 10 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer parts densely pilose, inner parts glabrous, inner 2 oblovate, 8−10 by 4−5 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse or incised, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments free, c. 3 mm long, anthers oblong c. 3 mm long, dehiscing by vertical slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale pink, densely pilose, 15−20 mm long, tepals 6, white or tinged pale pink, ovate to orbicular, 3−5 by 5−6 mm, densely pilose outside, styles 4, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary dark red or brownish green, densely pilose, 4-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruits a fleshy berry, densely pilose when young, glabrous when mature, drying dark brown, ovate, 20 by 15 mm Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 20−60 cm tall. Stems succulent, glossy, erect, glabrous, dark red or pale pink with red striations; tubers subglobose, 15−20 mm diam, with numerous fibrous roots. Leaves all in the same horizontal plane, 6 −7 (−8) per plant; petiole pale red, 5−20 mm long; lamina basifixed, succulent, strongly asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface sparsely scabrous, dull dark green, dark purplish black or dull green with white spots, iridescent, abaxial surface sparsely scabrous on veins, dark reddish, glossy; narrowly oblong-lanceolate and slightly falcate, 7−18 by 1.5−4 cm; base markedly asymmetric, one side cuneate, the other overlapping the petiole slightly apex elongate, margin serrate or slightly serrate, venation pinnate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 5−10 pairs of lateral veins branching per side, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath. Stipules persistent, pale green with dark red striations, lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, 10−12 by 4−5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, bisexual, 3−6 cm long, dichasial, with a few minute verrucula, branched 1−2 times, with 4−6 staminate flowers and 2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncle terete, 1.8−2.5 cm long, pale greenish-pink, scabrid, glossy. Bracts persistent, membranaceous, narrowly oblong, margin entire, apex obtuse or acute, pale green, glossy, 5−7 by 1 mm. Staminate flowers: pedicels pale greenish-pink 5−7 mm long, with a few minute verrucula, tepals 4, pale pink or pinkish-white with dark pinkish striations, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 7−8 by 5−6 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both side, inner 2 oblanceolate, 6−7 by 3−4 mm, base cuneate, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both side, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens 90−95, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, anthers c. 1 mm long, obcordate, dehiscing by short pore-like slits near tip, filaments fused at base. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale greenish-pink, 5−6 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, 3 obovate, 2 orbicular, 7−8 by 5−7 mm, pale pink with dark pinkish striations, base obtuse in obovate and rounded in orbicular tepals, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, once spirally twisted, yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped and compressed, seeming capitate, ovary with 3 subequal wings, 2-locular; placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, nodding and forming a splash-cup at maturity, glossy, pale greenish-pink with dark red striations, drying pale brown, 15 by 14−15 mm, locules ovate-oblong, 8−10 by 4−5 mm, adaxial wing obliquely crest-shaped with rounded apex, 10−12 mm long, lateral wings deltoid, curved along length of capsule, 7−8 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, ellipsoidal, 0.4−0.5 mm long, collar cells c. 3/4 length of seed.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 5−10 cm tall. Stems: tuber globose with numerous fibrous roots, 4−5 mm diam., aerial stem dark red, glabrous, brown when dry, 4−8 cm long. Leaves unifoliate, sessile, lamina basifixed; leaf blade succulent, chartaceous, symmetric or subsymmetric, adaxial surface sparsely echinate, light bright green or pale green, glossy, abaxial pale green; orbicular in cordate shaped, 4−10 by 5−10 cm, base cordate, apex rounded, margin entire or slightly crenate, venation palmate, veins 9−10, prominent beneath. Stipules not seen. Inflorescences terminal, dichasial, 1–2 times, bisexual, 8−10 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles terete 7−8 cm long, glabrous, dark red. Bracts not seen. Staminate flowers: pedicels greenish white, 5−10 mm long, glabrous, tepals 4, pinkish white, outer 2 orbicular, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 4−5 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens c. 12, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, anthers obcordate or obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip, filaments fused at base. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale pink, 4−10 mm long, tepals 5, pale pink, unequal, 4 ovate to oblong, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, 1 obovate, 4 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, pendulous, glossy, pale green, drying pale brown, 8−12 by 8−10 mm, locules elliptic, 7 by 8−10 mm, abaxial wing obliquely ligulate c. 10 mm long, lateral wings narrower, cucullate, c.1/3 of capsule length, 3−5 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.5 mm long.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 12−25 cm tall, whole plant covered with glandular hairs. Stems succulent, glossy, suberect with 2−5 branches, dark red at base, turning pale green near top; tubers irregularly heart-shaped with numerous fibrous roots, 5−13 mm diam. Leaves all in the same horizontal plane, alternate, 8−30 per plant, basifixed; petioles pale red, with an adaxial groove, 1.5−3 mm long, leaf blade membranaceous, subsymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface with dense glandular hairs, light green, glossy, iridescent, abaxial surface with dense glandular hairs, pale greenish white with red hyaline line along margin, narrowly lanceolate, 2−8 by 0.5−1 cm, base symmetric or subsymmetric, truncate or subcordate, apex caudate or more acuminate, margin dentate, midrib prominent beneath, hairy; lateral veins 7–8 on each side. Stipules persistent, pale green, triangular or ovate-triangular with sparse minute glandular hairs, c.1 by 1 mm, apex acuminate, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal or at least near the apex, dichasial, bisexual, 1−3 branches, 0.5−2.5 cm long with 2−4 staminate flowers and 2 pistillate flowers per branch; protandrous; peduncle, 0.5−1 cm long, terete, pale green, glossy, hairy. Bracts deciduous, membranous, ovate-triangular, oblong, 1−2 by 0.5−1 mm, apex acute, white, pale green, glossy, margin sparsely ciliate. Staminate flowers: pedicels 5−6 mm, sparsely hairy, tepals 4, plain white, outer 2 ovate or obovate, 2 by 2−3 mm, base cuneate, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both sides; inner 2 oblanceolate, 2 by 1 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium zygomorphic; stamens 10−12, yellow, filaments fused at base c.0.5 mm long, anthers cordate, c.1 mm long, dehiscing by longitudinal slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels white, sparsely hairy, 5−6 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, oblanceolate or obovate, plain white, 2−3 by 1−2 mm, base cuneate, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, yellow, stigmatic band kidney-shaped, papillose, ovary with 3 unequal wings, plain white, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, pendulous, creamy white, turning brown when dry, 15 by 10−12 mm, locules oblong, 4 by 1.5−2 mm, abaxial wing obliquely triangular, c. 3 mm long, lateral wings narrower, triangular, 1−2 mm long, c.1/3 capsule length. Seeds numerous, brown, ellipsoid.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, c. 5 cm tall. Stems erect, glabrous; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 2−5 mm in diam. Leaves 2−4(−5) per plant, basifixed; petiole, 1−3 cm long; leaf blade membranaceous, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, glabrous on both sides, palmatifid, 1−2.5 by 1.5−2 cm, base cordate, apex of each lobe acute, margin sinuate or deeply sinuate with 4−7 lobes, venation palmate, veins 4−5. Stipules persistent, lanceolate, 2 by 1 mm, glabrous, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, simple cymes, bisexual, 3−4 cm long; peduncles terete, 10−15 mm long, glabrous. Bracts persistent, membranaceous, lanceolate, c. 1 mm long, apex acute, margin entire. Staminate flowers: pedicels 2−3 mm, tepals 4, pale pink, outer 2 ovate, 4−5 by 4 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides; inner 2 oblong, 3−4 by 2−3 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens c.20, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, anthers obcordate c. 0.5 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip, filaments fused at base. Pistillate flowers: not seen. Fruits: 2-locular capsules , pendulous, drying pale brown, c. 5 by 5 mm, locules elliptic, 2−3 by 3 mm, abaxial wing orbicular with wavy curved on wing, 10−18 mm long, lateral wings narrower, shortly triangular, curved along length of capsule, 5 mm long. Seeds unknown.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 10–15 cm tall. Stems erect, terete, dark red, tuber globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 10 mm diam. Leaves 1–2 per plant, lamina dorsifixed; petiole dark red 2−5 cm long; leaf blade membranaceous, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, glabrous on both sides, adaxial surface dull dark green or light bright green, abaxial surface pale green, peltate, 3 by 7 cm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin crenate or undulate, venation palmate, veins 7−8, prominent beneath. Stipules caducous, narrowly lanceolate, c. 2 mm long. Inflorescences terminal, paniculate, bisexual, 8−15 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles terete, c. 6−8 cm long, dark red, densely glandular hairy. Bracts persistent, lanceolate, c. 2 by 1 mm; bracteoles 1 pair, opposite, lanceolate, c. 2 mm long. Staminate flowers: pedicels densely glandular hairy, c. 10 mm, tepals 4, white, outer 2 ovate, 5 by 4 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer parts pilose, inner parts glabrous, inner 2 linear oblanceolate, c. 3 by 1 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, elliptic, stamens 8−10, filaments fused at base, c. 0.5 mm long, anthers oblong, c. 1 mm long, thecae wing-like, dehiscing by vertical slit. Pistillate flowers: pedicels, c. 10 mm long, pale green, densely glandular hairy, tepals 3, plain white, outer 2 ovate, c. 5 by 4 mm, glabrous on both sides, inner 1 oblanceolate, c. 3 by 1 mm, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 3-locular, placentae unilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, drying pale brown, 8−10 by 10−13 mm with wings, locules ovate, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, abaxial triangular, c. 10 mm long, 2 lateral wings narrowly triangular, 4 mm curved along length of capsule. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 5–15 cm tall. Stems tuberous, globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 5–10 mm diam. Leaves unifoliate; petiole densely pilose, 4−10 cm long; leaf blade basifixed, subcoriaceous, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, glabrous on both sides, 6.5 by 6 cm, base cordate, apex acuminate, margin crenate or serrate, venation palmate, veins 5−7, prominent beneath. Stipules caducous, narrowly lanceolate, c. 2 mm long. Inflorescences arising from tuber, dichasial, bisexual, 5−10 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles terete, 4−8 cm long, densely pilose. Bracts persistent, lanceolate, c. 2 by 1 mm; bracteoles 1 pair, opposite, lanceolate, c. 2 by 1 mm. Staminate flowers: pedicels densely pilose, c. 4−10 mm, tepals 4, pink, outer 2, ovate, c. 6 by 5 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer parts densely pilose, inner parts glabrous, inner 2 linear oblanceolate, c. 5 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, filaments fused at base, c. 0.5 mm long, anthers oblong, c. 1 mm long, thecae thin, wing-like, dehiscing by vertical slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels c. 10 mm long, densely pilose, tepals 4, pink, outer 2 ovate, 5−6 by 4 mm, densely pilose outside, inner 2 oblanceolate, c. 4 by 2, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary dark red with 3 unequal wings, densely pilose, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, dark red, drying pale brown, 15−20 by 18−20 mm with wings, locules oblong, c.20 by 6−10 mm, abaxial triangular shaped, 15−20 mm long, 2 lateral wings narrower, narrowly triangular, 8 mm long, Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, c. 45 cm tall. Stem: base rhizomatous with numerous fibrous roots, creeping, 5−15 mm diam., aerial stem succulent, erect, terete with distinct swollen nodes. Stipules persistent, ovate-lanceolate, 12 by 5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Leaves horizontal, alternate, basifixed; petiole, 6−10 cm long, lamina succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, glabrous on both sides, ovate-oblong, 8−15 by 4−8 cm, base asymmetric, truncate, apex attenuate, margin incised or remotely serrate, venation palmate-pinnate, veins 6−7, midrib prominent beneath. Inflorescences axillary, bisexual, c. 15 cm long, dichasial, 1−2 branched; peduncle terete 4−7 cm long, glabrous. Bracts caducous, membranous, oblong-lanceolate; apex acute, margin entire, 5−7 by 1.5−3 mm. Staminate flowers: pedicels 5−10 mm, erect, glabrous, tepals 4, outer 2 ovate, 5−6 by 3−4 mm, base cuneate, rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 4−5 by 2−3 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, filaments free, c. 1.5 mm long, anthers reniform, c. 0.7 mm long, dehiscing by longitudinal slits near tip. Pistillate flowers: pedicels 5−10 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, glabrous, largest ovate c. 5 by 2 mm, smallest oblanceolate, 5−6 by 2 mm, styles 2, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, once spirally twisted, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent rain-splash capsule, pendulous, drying pale brown, 30–35 by 10 mm, locules ovate, 15 by 5−6 mm, abaxial wing ligulate with rounded tip, 20−25 mm long, lateral wings narrower, curved along length of capsule, 4−5 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 5−8 cm tall. Stems tuberous, globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5−8 mm diam. Leaves 1 (–2) per plant, basifixed; petiole pale green or sometimes dark red, brown when dry, 4−5 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface glabrous, light green or dull reddish brown, glossy, abaxial surface glabrous, pale green or vinaceous, palmatifid, 4−10 by 7−11 cm, leaf incision parted, base subcordate, apex acuminate, margin minutely double serrate, venation palmate, veins 6−8, prominent beneath. Stipules persistent, pale green, lanceolate, 1−3 by 1−2 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences arising from tuber, dichasial, bisexual, 8−12 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles terete c. 4−5 mm long, glabrous, dark red or reddish brown, glossy. Bracts persistent, membranaceous, lanceolate, 1−2 by 0.5−1 mm, pale green, glossy, apex acute, margin entire. Staminate flowers: pedicels 4−10 mm, ascending, tepals 4, plain white, outer 2 orbicular, 4−6 by 4−7 mm, base rounded, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer sides covering with minute echinate hairs, inside glabrous, inner 2 obovate, 4−5 by 4 mm, base cuneate, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens 30−40, bright yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 1 mm long, anthers obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by short slits near tip. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale green or dark red, 5−10 mm long, tepals 3, unequal, outer 2 orbicular, 4−6 by 4−7 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, outer sides with few minute echinate hairs, inside glabrous, inner 1 oblanceolate, 4−5 by 2 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, fused at base, bright yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped and covered with minute papillae, ovary with 3 unequal wings, pale green with red striations, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, glossy, pale green, pendulous, drying light brown, 5 by 11−12 mm, locules ovate, 5−6 by 5 mm, abaxial wing 10−12 mm long, 5–6 mm at base, 2 lateral wings shorter, triangular, 4−5 mm long, Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.5 mm long.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 20–90 cm tall. Stem erect, succulent, terete, dark red, rhizome elongate with numerous fibrous roots, brownish yellow, sparsely brown pubescent, 20–25 mm diam. Leaves 3–7 per plant; petiole 5−20 cm long, densely brown pubescent; leaf blade basifixed, subcoriaceous, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface glabrous, dull, dark green or dark green with white globular spots, abaxial surface sparsely brown pubescent on veins, pale green or pale pink on veins, glossy; ovate, 10−18 by 7−20 cm, base obliquely cordate, apex acuminate, margin entire or slightly serrate, venation palmate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 5−10 veins, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath. Stipules caducous, dark brown, ovate, 4−5 by 10 mm, apex acuminate, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, bisexual, 10−20 cm long, dichasial or polychasial, branching 1–2 times with 3–10 staminate flowers and 2–6 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncle terete 7−15 cm long, dark red with dense, brown pubescent hairs. Bracts caducous, dark red, ovate, brown villous, 0.5−15 by 4−10 mm, apex acute, margin ciliate. Staminate flowers: pedicels pale green, brown villous, 10−20 mm long, tepals 4, white or pale pink, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 10−15 by 10−12 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 7−12 by 5−10 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse or rounded, margin entire, glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 2 mm long, anthers oblong or obovate, c. 2 mm long, dehiscing vertical by slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale pink, sparsely pubescent, c. 10−20 mm long, tepals 6, white or pale pink, unequal, outer 3 ovate to orbicular, c. 20 by 10 mm, glabrous on both sides, inner 3 obovate, 13−15 by 8−10 mm, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, stigmatic band crescent-shaped and spiral, ovary dark red or pale pink, densely brown tomentose, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, dark red or pale green with sparse hairs, drying pale brown, 18−20 by 20 mm, locules oblong, c.12 by 10 mm, abaxial wing obliquely orbicular or ligulate, c. 15 mm long, 2 laterals narrower, rectangular, curved along length of capsule, 4−5 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 5–10 cm tall. Stems succulent, glossy, erect or suberect, densely stellate hairy, dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5−10 mm in diam. Leaves only 1−2 per plant, basifixed; petiole dark red, reddish brown when dry, 2−4 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface sparsely stellate hairy, dull light green or dark green, glossy, iridescent, abaxial surface pale green or vinaceous, densely stellate hairy especially on veins, 3−17 by 3−13 cm, base cordate, apex acute, margin serrate or sinuate or remotely sinuate with stellate hairs, venation palmate, veins 6−8. Stipules caducous, dark red, ovate-lanceolate, 4−5 by 2−3 mm long, densely stellate hairy, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, dichasial, bisexual, branched 1−2 times, 4−17 cm long, with many staminate flowers and 1–2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncles terete, 3−14 cm long, pale green or dark red, glossy, glabrous. Bracts persistent, membranous, light pink, glossy, ovate-lanceolate, 2−5 by 2 mm, densely hairy, apex obtuse, margin entire. Staminate flowers: pedicels 3−10 mm, erect (or occasionally ascending), tepals 4, white or pale pink, outer 2 orbicular, 4−7 by 4−7 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 4−7 by 2−3 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, fused at base, anthers obcordate or obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale pink, 4−10 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, white or pale pink, 3 ovate oblong, 4−7 by 4−7 mm, 2 obovate, 2−5 by 1−2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, glossy, pale green, pendulous, drying pale brown, 8−15 by 5−10 mm, locules elliptic, 10−25 by 8−10 mm, abaxial wing concave with wavy curved on wing, 10−18 mm long, lateral wings narrower, slightly triangular, curved along length of capsule, 3−5 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.5 mm long.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 15–70 cm tall. Stems erect, dark red, terete, very densely dark red pilose, rhizome with numerous fibrous roots, brownish yellow, elongate, very densely dark red pilose, 10–15 mm in diam. Leaves 3–7 per plant, lamina basifixed; petiole 4−25 cm long, very densely dark red pilose; leaf blade subcoriaceous, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface densely pilose hairs, dull dark green or dull dark grey green, abaxial surface very densely dark red pilose, glossy, ovate, 7−22 by 7−12 cm, base obliquely cordate, apex acuminate, margin ciliate, venation palmate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 7−8 veins, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath. Stipules persistent, dark red, ovate, 10 by 12 mm, densely dark red pilose, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, bisexual, 10−30 cm long, dichasial or polychasial, branching 1–2 times with 3–7 staminate flowers and 2–4 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncle, 10−22 cm long, terete, sparsely dark red pilose. Bracts caducous, ovate, densely dark red pilose, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, apex acute, margin ciliate. Staminate flowers pedicels greenish white, sparsely dark red pilose, 15−20 mm long, tepals 4, orange-red, outer 2 ovate to rhomboid, 10−15 by 8−15 mm, base obtuse, apex acute, margin entire, outer parts densely dark red tomentose, inner 2 rhomboid or obovate, 8−10 by 7−8 mm, base obtuse, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 2 mm long, anthers oblong or obovate, c. 2 mm long, dehiscing by vertical slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels greenish white, sparsely dark red tomentose, 15−20 mm long, tepals 5, orange-red, unequal, outer 4 ovate, 10−12 by 6−8 mm, base obtuse, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both sides or sparsely dark red tomentose outside, inner 1 oblong, 10 by 8 mm, base obtuse, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary orange-red, glabrous, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, pale green to orange-red, drying pale brown, 20−30 by 20 mm, capsules oblong, 5 by 15 mm, abaxial wing triangular, c. 20 mm long, 2 lateral wings narrower, triangular, curved along length capsule, 4−5 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 5–20 cm tall. Stems tuberous, globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 5 mm diam. Leaves unifoliate, lamina dorsifixed; petiole dark red, glabrous, 4−20 cm long; leaf blade subcoriaceous, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface dull dark green or dark grey green, strigose, abaxial surface pale green, densely strigose, 2−9 by 4−11 cm, base cordate and overlapping, apex rounded, margin serrate, ciliate, venation palmate, veins 7−12, prominent beneath. Stipules not seen. Inflorescences arising from tuber, cymose, bisexual, 10−13 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles terete, 10−11 cm long, dark red or pale green, glabrous. Bracts persistent, cuneiform with fimbriate apex, 4 by 2 mm. Staminate flowers: pedicels glabrous, sparsely hairy, 10−15 mm, tepals 4, pink or pinkish white, outer dark pink, outer 2, obovate, 10 by 11 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, outer parts densely hairy at middle, inside glabrous, inner 2 narrowly oblong, 5−7 by 2−3 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, filaments fused at base, c. 1 mm long, anthers obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels 10−15 mm long, pale pink, glabrous, tepals 2−3(−4), pink or pinkish white, outsides dark red, outer 2 orbicular, c. 8 by 9 mm, glabrous on both sides, inner 1(−2), oblong, c. 8 by 1−2, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 unequal wings, sparsely pubescent, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, drying pale brown, 10 by 15 mm with wings, locules oblong, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, abaxial triangular, c. 10 mm long, 2 lateral wings narrower, triangular, 4 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, ca 60 cm tall. Stems rhizomatous, rhizome elongate, creeping, 15−20 mm diam, with numerous fibrous roots. Leaves: petiole reddish brown when dry, 20−90 cm long, lamina basifixed, succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface sparsely pubescent, dull dark green, abaxial surface sparsely hairy on veins, ovate, 14−20 by 10−20 cm, base cordate, apex acuminate, margin dentate-ciliate, venation palmate, 9−10 veins, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath. Stipules caducous, ovate, c. 5 by 7 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, bisexual, 50−60 cm long, polychasial, branching 1–2 times with many staminate flowers, protandrous; peduncle terete, densely pilose, dark red, 25−60 cm long. Bracts caducous, leafy, ovate, apex obtuse, margin ciliate, pale green, glossy. Staminate flowers: pedicels pale pink, 10 mm long, tepals 4, deep pink, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 10 by 9 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin slightly crenate, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 10 by 4−5 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse or truncate, margin entire, glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments nearly free, c. 3 mm long, anthers oblong, 1−1.5 mm long, dehiscing vertical by slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale pink, 10−20 mm long, tepals 3, deep pink, outer 2 orbicular, 10 by 11 mm, glabrous, inner 1 obovate, 10 by 8 mm, styles 3, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary glabrous with 3 unequal wings, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, very hairy with glandular hairs when young, glabrous when mature, drying pale brown, 20−25 by 10−15 mm, locules ovate-oblong, 10 by 7 mm, abaxial wing triangular or crest-shaped, c. 10 mm long, c. 10 mm wide at base, 2 laterals narrower, crest-shaped, curved along length of capsule, 2−3 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 10–15 cm tall. Stems erect, succulent, terete, dark red, glabrous, tuber globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5–10 mm diam. Leaves 3–7 per plant, lamina basifixed; petiole dark red, 0.5−4 cm long; leaf blade membranaceous, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface dull dark green or light bright green, abaxial surface pale green, glossy, glabrous on both sides, ovate or triangular, 4–8 by 1.5–4 cm, base cordate or truncate, apex elongate, acuminate, margin crenate or undulate, venation palmate, veins 7−8, prominent beneath. Stipules caducous, narrowly lanceolate, c. 2 mm long. Inflorescences terminal, paniculate, bisexual, 5−10 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles, 1−2 cm long, terete, dark red, glabrous. Bracts persistent, ovate, fimbriate, 3 by 2 mm; bracteoles 1 pair, opposite, ovate, fimbriate, c. 3 mm long. Staminate flowers: pedicels white, densely glandular hairy, c. 3 mm long, tepals 4, white, outer 2, ovate, c. 3 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer parts densely glandular hairy, inner parts glabrous, inner 2 linear oblanceolate, c. 3 by 1 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium zygomorphic, stamens 10−12, filaments fused at base, c. 0.5 mm long, anthers oblong, c. 0.5 mm long, thecae wing-like, dehiscing by slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels c. 4 mm long, white, densely glandular hairy, tepals 5, plain white, outer parts with dense glandular hairs, subequal, obovate to oblanceolate, 2−3 by 1−2 mm, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 equal wings, 3-locular, placentae unilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, drying pale brown, 4−6 by 4−5 mm with 3 unequal wings, locules ovate, 2−3 by 3 mm, abaxial wing triangular, c. 4 mm long, 2 lateral wings narrower, narrowly triangular, 2 mm long, curved along length of capsule. description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 8–10 cm tall. Tuber subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 4−7 mm diam. Leaves unifoliate, basifixed; petiole pale green, brown when dry, sessile to 5 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface with scattered minute hairs, dull dark green, glossy, abaxial surface glabrous, pale green, suborbicular-cordate, 2−5 by 2−6 cm, base cordate, apex obtuse, margin crenate with minute hairs, venation palmate, veins 5−8, inconspicuous on both sides. Stipules caducous, pale green, lanceolate, 2−3 by 1−2 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences axillary, subtended by a pair of leafy bracts, dichasial, branched 1−2 times, bisexual, 4−8 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles c. 2−5 cm long, terete, minutely pubescent, pale green, glossy. Bracts leafy, 1 pair, 1.5−4.5 by 1−2 cm. Staminate flowers: pedicels pale green, 5−7 mm, ascending, tepals 4, outer 2 obovate, obtuse at apex, up to 6 by 7 mm, plain white, outside with dense minute hairs, inner 2 obovate, 6–7 by 2–3 mm, glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens 8–10, filaments fused at base into a ca. 1 mm long column, the free parts to 1 mm long; anthers narrowly oblong, 1.5–2.0 by 1.5 mm, yellow, obtuse at apex, opening by two sublateral slits along whole length of anther. Pistillate flowers: pedicel ca. 5 mm long, tepals 4, shape, size, colour and indumentum similar to those of staminate flower, styles 3, free, crescent-shaped, 4–5 mm long, stigmatic surface papillose, ovary stellately triangular, with three narrowly conical horn-like projections, pale green, pubescent when young, ca. 8–10 by 2–3 mm, 3-locular, placentation free central, placentae 1 per locule. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, shaped as ovary, 9–10 by 3–4 mm, dehiscence by longitudinal slits on upper surface. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 10−20 cm tall. Stems succulent, glossy, erect to suberect, glabrous, dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 5−10 mm diam. Leaves 2−5 per plant, basifixed, alternate; petiole dark red, brown when dry, 1−8 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric or subsymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface scabrous, dull dark green, glossy, abaxial surface glabrous, glaucous, lanceolate in cordate shaped or cordate, 10−11 by 4−5 cm, base cordate, apex acuminate or elongate-acuminate, margin irregularly crenate, venation palmate, veins 6−8, midrib and veins grooved on adaxial surface. Stipules persistent, pale green, lanceolate, 3−4 by 2 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, paniculate, bisexual, 5−15 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles c. 5−8 mm long, terete with dense minute glandular hairs, dark red or reddish brown, glossy. Bracts persistent, membranaceous, pale green, glossy, ovate or oblong, 4−5 by 3 −5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Staminate flowers: pedicels 2−5 mm, ascending, tepals 4, creamy white or pale pink, outer 2 ovate, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outsides covered with minute multicellular glandular hairs, inside glabrous, inner 2 oblanceolate, 4−5 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens 55−60, yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 0.3 mm long, anthers obcordate, c. 0.5 mm long, dehiscing by pores at tip. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale pink or dark red, 6−10 mm long, tepals 5, subequal, obovate, 10−12 by 2−5 mm, whitish pink, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outside covered with minute multicellular hairs, inside glabrous, styles 3, fused at base, forked once, yellow, stigmatic band kidney-shaped, ovary with 3 equal wings, pale green or pale pink, 3-locular, placentae unilamellate. description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 5−30 cm tall. Stems succulent, erect, glabrous, dark red with red striations or dark red; tubers globose, 10−20 mm diam, with numerous fibrous roots. Leaves distant, alternate, 2−5(−6) per plant; petiole vinaceous, 3−10 mm long; lamina basifixed, succulent, strongly asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface glabrous, dull dark green, dark brown or dull green with white spots or silvery spots and blotches through veins, iridescent, abaxial surface pale green, dark reddish, glossy, obliquely ovate, 5−14 by 3.5−4.5 cm, base markedly asymmetric, basal lobe elongate, apex elongate, margin crenate, venation palmate-pinnate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 4−6 pairs of lateral veins branching, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath. Stipules persistent, pale green or pale green with dark red striations, lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, 8−10 by 4−5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, bisexual, 3−10 cm long, dichasial, branched 1−2 times, with 6−8 staminate flowers and 2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncle terete, pale green or dark red, glossy, 1.5−8 cm long. Bracts persistent, membranaceous, ovate, 5−7 by 5 −6 mm, apex obtuse or acute, margin entire, pale green with red striation, glossy. Staminate flowers: pedicels dark red 5−7 mm long, glabrous, tepals 4, white with dark red striations or plain white, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 7−10 by 4−8 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblanceolate, 6−7 by 3−4 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, pale yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 0.5 mm long, anthers obovoid, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by short slits near tip. Pistillate flowers: pedicels dark red, 5−6 mm long, tepals 5(–6), unequal, outer 4 obovate, 5−6 by 3−4 mm, inner one 1 oblanceolate, 5−6 by 2−3 mm, white with dark red striations, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2 (forked once), fused at base, bright yellow, stigmatic band crescent−shaped, ovary with 3 subequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, nodding, pendulous, glossy, green with dark red striations, drying pale brown, 10−20 by 10−15 mm, locules ovate-oblong, 4−10 by 4−8 mm, abaxial wing broadly triangular, 8−20 mm long, lateral wings deltoid, curved along length of capsule, 5−8 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.4 mm long, collar cells c. ½ length of seed.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, c. 30 cm tall. Stems rhizomatous, c.10 mm diam. with numerous fibrous roots. Inflorescences arising from rhizome, bisexual, 12−30 cm long, dichasial, branching once, protandrous; peduncle terete, 10−25 cm long, glabrous, dark red, glossy. Bracts not seen. Staminate flowers: pedicels 10−20 mm long, tepals 4, white, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 16 by 13 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 obovate, 10 by 5 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse or truncate, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, filaments fused at base, c. 3 mm long, anthers oblong, c. 1.5 mm long, dehiscing by vertical slits. Pistillate flowers: pedicels c. 20 mm long, tepals 4, orbicular, glabrous on both sides, c. 10−12 by 10−12 mm, styles 2, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, spiral, ovary glabrous with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular; placentae bilamellate. description: Monoecious, cane-like, caulescent herb, 70−140 cm tall. Rhizome elongate with numerous roots;aerial stem translucent, glossy, erect, glabrous, dark red or greenish red, darker above nodes. Leaves many, basifixed, alternate; petiole dark red with short brown hairs, brown when dry, 1−1.5 cm long; lamina succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface glabrous, dark green and velvety, iridescent, abaxial surface glabrous, pale green or reddish purple, obovate-oblong, 8−16 by 4−7 cm, base oblique, apex elongate, margin crimson and toothed at vein endings, venation palmate-pinnate, veins 6−8, midrib and veins grooved on adaxial surface, prominent beneath. Stipules persistent, pale green, lanceolate, 10−20 by 1.5−3.5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. Inflorescences terminal, paniculate, 4−10 cm long, staminate flowers distal, pistillate flowers basal, protogynous; peduncles pale green, terete, glabrous, 2−3 cm long. Bracts caducous, foliaceous, pale green, 4−6 by 3−4 mm, glabrous, apex acute, margin entire. Staminate flowers: pedicels 4−8 mm, ascending, tepals 2, greenish white, vinaceous at tip, oval, 5−7 by 1.5−5 mm, base obtuse, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, subglobose, stamens many, pale yellow, filaments c. 0.7 mm long, anthers cordate, c. 10 mm long, dehiscing by short slits at tip, fused at base, androphore shorter than androecium, c. 1 mm. Pistillate flowers: pedicels pale green, 6−7 mm long, tepals 5 (−6), subequal, pale green or greenish pink, oblong, 14−15 by 6−9 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin jagged toothed towards tip, outermost covering with minute hairs, inside glabrous, innermost obovate or oblong, slightly smaller, 10−13 by 5−7 mm, styles 3, fused at base, forked once, pale yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 equal wings, glabrous, pale green, dark red, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. Fruit a dehiscent capsule, pendulous, glossy, pale green or dark red, drying pale brown, glabrous, 18−20 by 14−20 mm, locules oblong, 18−20 by 14−18 mm, 3 equal wings, triangular with rounded tip, splitting between locules, c. 10 mm long. Seeds numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, c. 0.3mm long, collar cells ¾ of length of seed.
contributor: Phutthai, T., Hughes, M & Sridith, K
bibliographic_Citation: Phutthai, T., Hughes, M & Sridith, K, 2019, Begoniaceae , in K. Chayamarit, H. Balslev, M. F. Newman, A. S. Barfod, H. J. Esser, D. A. Simpson, & J. A. N. Parnell (eds.) , Flora of Thailand Vol.14(3)., pp.259-431.

description: Creeping herb, 15 – 28 cm long, strigose; rhizome 5–10 × 1–1.5 cm, internodes very short at base, becoming a creeping stem toward apex with internodes 1–4 cm long, mixed with more congested internodes so leaves can appear crowded together, stipules triangular to elliptic-ovate, 1–1.6 × 0.8–1.2 cm, glabrous adaxially, pubescent abaxially, margin ciliate, apex shortly acuminate. Stem decumbent, 8–22 × 0.3–0.5 cm, rooting at nodes, indumentum strigose (trichomes c. 5 mm long), red. Leaves appearing clustered when internodes are close together, on 6–20 × 0.2–0.3 cm petioles; lamina elliptic-ovate, 8–30 × 6–18 cm, rugulose, apex acute to shortly acuminate, base cordate with lobes overlapping, margin subentire, crenate, or serrate, ciliate, densely strigose, veins palmate, 7–9. Inflorescence axillary, cymose; peduncles strigose, primary 7.3–20 cm long, secondary 1.3–7.5 cm long, tertiary 0.5–4.5 cm long; bracts lanceolate to elliptic-ovate, 0.5–1 × 0.3–0.6 cm, acute, entire, pubescent, with a pedicel 1–2 cm long. Staminate flower with 4 tepals; outer tepals 2, broadly ovate to orbicular, 1.3–2 × 1–1.5 cm, glabrous inside, pubescent outside, pink; inner tepals 2, ovate to elliptic ovate, 1–1.3 × 0.5–0.7 cm, glabrescent outside, glabrous inside, pinkish white; stamens 30–60, anthers basifixed, ellipticobovate, c. 2 mm long, connective retuse, filament c. 1.5 mm long, fused at base into a stout column; pedicel 2.5–4 cm long, strigose. Pistillate flower with 5 tepals, unequal, elliptic ovate to broadly ovate, 1–1.3 × 0.9–1.2 cm, strigose outside, glabrous inside, pink; pistil c. 2–3 mm long, styles 2, c. 1 mm long, persistent, stigma papillose, yellow, ovary 2-locular, placentae bifid; pedicel 1–2 cm long, strigose. Capsule 1.2–1.5 cm long, densely strigose, with 1 oblong central wing and 2 shorter obtuse lateral wings, central wing 1–2 × 0.8–1 cm, lateral wings 1–1.2 × 0.3–0.5 cm.
contributor: Borah D., Taram M. & Hughes M.
bibliographic_Citation: Borah D., Taram M. & Hughes M. 2023, Begonia egamii (Begoniaceae), a remarkable new species from Arunachal Pradesh, India, Candollea. Vol.78(2) , pp.147-151 (https://doi.org/10.15553/c2023v782a5)

description: Rhizomatous, monoecious herb, 10–20 cm high. Rhizome 7–10 mm wide, densely strigose, internodes 1–1.5 cm long. Stipules subulate, 6–10 mm × 4–5 mm, glabrescent, hairs prominent on mid veined, margin entire, apex aristate, arista up to 3 mm long. Leaves 15–20 × 14–18 cm; petiole 7–10 × c. 0.3 cm, densely pubescent, lamina deeply palmately lobed, narrowly ovate to suborbicular, basifixed, base cordate, 7–11 × 6–10 cm, slightly asymmetric, adaxially sparsely pubescent, abaxially pubescent along veins; venation palmate, with 4 or 5 main veins; lobes 5, sometimes with 2 smaller lobes at the base, main two lobes sharing a vein at the base, elongate-triangular, margin deeply and broadly dentate, the dentitions finely serrate; apices acute to acuminate. Inflorescence axillary, up to 4–7 flowered cyme; peduncle densely pubescent, branching 2–3 times, primary 23.5 cm, secondary 0.4–0.8 cm, tertiary 0.1–0.4 mm long; bracts subulate, 3–7mm×25 mm. Staminate flower: pedicel 1–1.5 cm long, pubescent; tepals 4, white to pink; outer tepals 2, ovate to obovate, 1.2–2×1–1.7 cm, sparsely pubescent outside, denser near base, margin entire; inner tepals 2, obovate or oblong, 1.2–1.8 × 0.7–1 cm, glabrous; 90–110 stamens, c. 2 mm long, filaments c. 1 mm long, unequal, fused at base into a short column; anther obovate, c. 1 mm long, connective retuse. Pistillate flower: pedicel 11.6 cm long, pubescent; tepals 5, unequal, elliptic-ovate, 1.8–2.3 × 1–2 cm, white to pale pink, pubescent outside, glabrous inside; pistil 5–6 mm long, styles 2, 2–4mm long, forked and twisted; ovary 1 cm × 0.8 cm, covered with very dense short fleshy hairs, 2-locular, placentae bifid. Capsule oblong-ellipsoid, 1–1.2 × 1.5–1.7 cm, with dense short hairs; central wings 0.9–1.2 × 0.5–0.8 mm, triangular to rounded-oblong; lateral wings c. 1 mm × 0.5–0.8 cm.
bibliographic_Citation: 2024, A new species Begonia ziroensis and a new record of Begonia siamensis from Arunachal Pradesh, Northeast India, N. Z. J. Bot (https://doi.org/10.1080/0028825X.2023.2295439)

description: Herbaceous perennials; rhizomes repent, often branching, rooting at the nodes; internodes slender, elongate, 2.1–6.8 cm long, 1.8–5.5 mm thick, glabrous, sparsely villous at the nodes with trichomes 1–3 mm; stipules tardily deciduous, lanceolate, (8–)10–19 × 4–9 mm, marginally entire, glabrous. Leaves with petiole 6.2–32 cm, glabrous to villous with trichomes 1–3 mm; blade chartaceous, asymmetrical, transversely ovate, 7.8–14 × 4–8.6 cm, lacking lobes; base cordate, sinus to 2.1 cm deep, basal lobes not overlapping; apex attenuate-acuminate; margin short-ciliate, serrulate; adaxial surface glabrous, abaxial surface sparsely pilose with trichomes to 0.5 mm, sparsely to densely pilose on major veins; venation 6- to 9-palmatinerved. Inflorescences usually longer than leaves, cymose, fewflowered; peduncle 6.4–21 cm, sparsely villous with trichomes 0.5–1 mm; bracts caducous, the lowermost occasionally obovate, ca. 10 × 5 mm, villous, marginally eciliate. Staminate flowers: pedicel 9–27 mm; tepals 4, outer 2 fleshy but membranaceous upon drying, suborbicular, 10–19 × 10.5–19 mm, externally glabrous; inner 2 narrowly oblanceolate, 10.2–18 × 4.5–7.5 mm; stamens 25 to 30; filaments 1.5–2 mm, inserted on a low torus; anthers narrowly oblong, 2.1– 3.4 × 0.4–0.5 mm, connectives extended to 0.4 mm. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 5–7 mm; bracteoles lacking; tepals 3, fleshy but membranaceous upon drying, the largest 2 orbicular, 6–8 × 6–7 mm, externally glabrous to sparsely villous at the base, the smallest elliptic, ca. 3 × 1 mm; ovary bilocular with bipartite placentae, 5–8 mm, villous; wings 3, unequal, the largest triangular, 3–6 × 3–6 mm, villous, marginally ciliate, the second and third reduced to a marginal ridge 0.5–1.5 mm wide, villous, marginally ciliate; styles 2, ca. 2 mm, fused briefly basally; stigmas dilated-lunate or weakly bicornute. Fruits unknown.
contributor: Moonlight P.W. & Kelly D.L.
bibliographic_Citation: Moonlight P.W. & Kelly D.L. 2024, Two New Critically Endangered Species of Begonia sect. Gireoudia (Begoniaceae) from Mesoamerica, Novon. Vol.32.

description: Herbaceous perennial; rhizomes repent, branching, rooting at the nodes; internodes slender, elongate, 0.5–8 cm long, 0.3–8 mm thick, sparsely tomentose to tomentose at the nodes; stipules early deciduous, unknown. Leaves with petiole 18–36 cm, sparsely tomentose to tomentose; blades chartaceous, subsymmetrical, broadly ovate in outline, 8–15 × 9–18.5 cm, with 5 to 9 lobes, lobes irregular, narrowly acuminate, 0.8–4 cm deep; base cordate, sinus to 2.1 cm deep, basal lobes not overlapping or overlapping; apex indistinct, short acuminate to acuminate; margin dentate, ciliate; adaxial surface glabrous, abaxial surface tomentose to densely tomentose on major veins, otherwise glabrous; venation 6- to 8-palmatinerved. Inflorescences generally equal in height to leaves, cymose, few-flowered; peduncle 20–24 cm, sparsely tomentose to tomentose; bracts caducous, broadly ovate, 5–14 × 4–8 mm, marginally eciliate, glabrous. Staminate flowers: pedicel 6–34 mm; tepals 2 or 3, fleshy but membranaceous upon drying, the outer 2 ovate, 13–16 × 11–14 mm, glabrous, the inner lacking or elliptic, ca. 5 × 1 mm, glabrous; stamens ca. 25; filaments 1–1.5 mm, inserted on a low torus; anthers narrowly oblong, 1.6–2 × 0.4 mm, connectives extended to 0.4 mm. Pistillate flowers: pedicels ca. 30 mm; bracteoles lacking; tepals 2, fleshy but membranaceous upon drying, orbicular, 14–17 × 12–14 mm, glabrous; ovary bilocular with bipartite placentae, 5–7 mm, villous; wings 3, unequal, the largest triangular, 1–4 × 3–6 mm, villous, marginally ciliate, the second and third reduced to a marginal ridge ca. 0.5 mm wide, villous, marginally ciliate; styles 2, ca. 4 mm, fused briefly basally; stigmas dilated-lunate or weakly bicornute. Fruits the same shape as the ovary, expanding to 6 mm long; wings the same shape as in flower, the largest expanding to 5 × 6 mm, the second and third expanding to 2 mm wide.
contributor: Moonlight P.W. & Kelly D.L.
bibliographic_Citation: Moonlight P.W. & Kelly D.L. 2024, Two New Critically Endangered Species of Begonia sect. Gireoudia (Begoniaceae) from Mesoamerica, Novon. Vol.32.

description: Monoecious, perennial, rhizomatous herb, up to 25 cm tall. Rhizome ca. 10 × 0.8 cm, internodes congested, pilose. Stipules persistent, dark red, triangular, 1–1.8 × 0.7–1 cm, adaxially glabrous, abaxially hirsute at midrib, margin entire, apex aristate. Leaves alternate, herbaceous; petiole pale green, 7–16 cm long, purplish-red pilose; blade ovate to ovate-orbicular, thick chartaceous, succulent, base cordate with lobes overlapping, 6–14 × 5–10 cm, asymmetric, apex attenuate or acute, margin erose to undulate, red hirsute; adaxial surface olive green with blue iridescence, sparsely white puberulous; abaxial surface purplish-red, sparsely red tomentose on veins only; venation palmate, prominent, lamina slightly bulged between veins. Inflorescences axillary, bisexual, cymose, arising directly from rhizome, branching one time only, ca. 15 cm long, 2–6 flowered, female flowers rare; peduncle pale green, 7–12 cm long, sparsely reddish-pink puberulent; bracts caduceus or persistent, widely ovate, white, 1–1.8 × 0.8–1.3 cm, adaxially glabrous, abaxially red hirsute, margin denticulate, red hispid, apex acute. Staminate flower, pedicel 1.5–2 cm long, pale green, sparsely reddish-pink puberulent, tepals 4, white or slightly pink in the margin, outer 2 tepals widely ovate to orbicular, 1.6–2.3 × 1.4–1.8 cm, adaxially glabrous, abaxially red hirsute spreading from base to apex, apex round, inner 2 tepals elliptic to oblanceolate, 1.2–1.4 × 0.7–0.8 cm, glabrous on both surfaces; androecium with 80–160 stamens, asymmetric, yellow; filaments 0.8–1.3 mm long, unequal, fused at base, anthers narrowly obovate, ca. 1.2 × 0.7 mm, apex obtuse to truncate. Pistillate flower, pedicel 0.5–1.2 cm long, pale green, sparsely reddish-pink puberulent, tepals 5 or 6, white or slightly pink in the margin, ovate to orbicular, outer 4 or 5 tepals almost similar in shape and size, 1–1.4 × 0.7–1 cm, adaxially glabrous, abaxially red hirsute spreading from base to apex, apex acute or round, inner 1 tepal slightly smaller than outer tepals, ovate to orbicular, 0.9–1 × 0.8–0.9 cm, both surfaces glabrous, apex round or sometimes lobed; ovary trigonous-ellipsoid, ca. 7 mm long, ca. 4 mm wide (excluding wings), reddishpink, hirsute, wings 3, unequal, one long-triangular, ca. 5 mm, two short wings, bi-locular, placentation axillary, placentae bifid; styles 2, green, fused at base, 2-lobed; stigma spirally twisted, green. Fruit not seen.
contributor: Hajong B., Bhat N.A. & Bharali P.
bibliographic_Citation: Hajong B., Bhat N.A. & Bharali P. 2024, A new species of Begonia (Begoniaceae) from Mishmi Hills of Arunachal Pradesh, India, Phytotaxa. Vol.637(3) , pp.285-290.

description: Monoecious, perennial, erect, branched herb, ca. 1 m. tall, stems green to reddish brown, terete, 5–8 mm in diam., internodes 3–5 cm long, antrorsely densely brown pubescent (ca. 0.5 mm long). Stipules sub-persistent, greenish brown, ovate with prominent keel, 15–18 × 8–12 mm, adaxially glabrous, abaxially pubescent on vein and sparsely elsewhere, base rounded, margin entire, apex long acuminate, acumen ca. 1.5 mm long. Leaves alternate, 11-15 cm long (length of petiole + lamina); petiole reddish brown, terete, 5–10 mm long, 3–4 mm in diam., antrorsely brown pubescent; lamina inequilateral, ovate-elliptic, 11–14 × 5.0–6.5 cm, adaxially green, sparsely red hirsute on interveins (hairs ca. 1.5 mm long), abaxially pale green with reddish brown veins, pubescent on vein (ca. 1 mm long), base subcordate, margins irregularly and sparsely dentate, apex acuminate; venation palmate, slightly canaliculate adaxially, abaxially protruding. Inflorescence terminal, staminate flower parts a branched raceme, each branch dichasial at base and raceme apically, each raceme holding up to 10 flowers, ca. 8 cm long, blooming consecutively, panicle 4–8 cm long, pistillate flower is basal to staminate parts, peduncles green to red, 15–20 mm long, 3 mm in diam., glabrous. Bracts caducous, membranaceous, pale green to pink, oblong-ovate, boat-shaped, lowest pair ca. 9 × 4 mm ̧ adaxially glabrous, abaxially sparse pubescent, margin entire, apex acuminate. Staminate flower pedicels pink 5–10 mm long, antrorsely pubescent; tepals 2, white to pink, broadly ovate, ca. 12 × 12 mm, outer side sparse pink pubescent, inner side glabrous, base cordate, margin entire, apex rounded, androecium zygomorphic, ca. 4–5 wide; stamens 1.5–2.0 mm, anthers obovoid, 1 mm long. Pistillate flower pedicel 10–15 mm long, antrorsely pubescent; tepals 5, white to pink, broadly ovate to elliptic, 12–14 × 8–13 mm, outer side sparse pink pubescent, inner side glabrous, base cuneate, margin entire, apex obtuse to rounded; ovary trigonal-ellipsoidal, pinkish pale red, 14–17 × 5–7 mm (wings excluded), antrorsely red pubescent; wings 3, subequal, narrowly triangular to ovate-trapezoidal, 16–18 × 5–7 mm, proximally rounded to cuneate, distally truncated; locules 3, placentation bifid; styles 3, ca. 3 mm long; stigmas in a spirally twisted band and papillose all around. Fruits with a stiff pedicel, 10–15 mm long, recurved such that the fruit positions horizontally under the leaves, capsules brown ̧ trapezoidal in outline, 16–18 × 20–22 mm, glabrous, base rounded to subtruncate, apex truncate, dehiscing along the attachments of the wings.
contributor: Dela Cruz C.J.P., Collantes J.P.R., Bustamante R.A.A. & Ang Y.P.
bibliographic_Citation: Dela Cruz C.J.P., Collantes J.P.R., Bustamante R.A.A. & Ang Y.P. 637, Insights on Begonia jagori (Begoniaceae), a cryptic species of Albay Province, Luzon Island, Philippines, Phytotaxa. Vol.3(2024) , pp.291-295.

description: Herb deciduous perennial; tubers spherical, 5–10 mm in diameter, 2–5 connected, arranged in a straight line or irregularly, white from the current year, red from the previous years; aerial stem absent or occasionally very short. Leaf: solitary; petiole green or red, ungrooved, 0.7–6.5 cm long, 1–2 mm thick, white or red pubescent; blade slightly asymmetric to rarely near symmetrical, broadly ovate-cordate, occasionally longovate to lanceolate, rarely elliptic, 3.2–20 × 2.7–15 cm, wide side 1.4–9.5 cm, narrow side 1.3–7.5 cm, basal lobe 0.1–6 cm downward extended; adaxial surface mostly green, rarely dark red, densely covered by short pubescence; abaxially light green, rarely purple-red, sparsely pubescent along the veins, pubescence more and longer on the main veins; apex acute, rarely blunt; base slightly oblique to rarely near symmetrical, cordate, occasionally near blunt; margin unequally triangularly serrated, with cilia up to 1 mm long; venation palmate, veins 7 or 8, abaxial veins slightly impressed, abaxially obviously raised; Inflorescence 1, occasionally 2, dichasial cyme, 3–15 cm long, branched 0–3 times, 1–35 flowers per inflorescence; peduncle 2.2–9.5 cm long, 0.63 mm thick, red or pink, glabrous. Bract red or green, membranous, glabrous, narrowly triangular, small, 1–3 × 0.4–2 mm; apex acuminate. Staminate flower: 10–21 × 10–20 mm; tepals 4, pink, glabrous; outer 2, ovate to oval, 5–11 × 5–10 mm, apex blunt, longitudinal veins clear; inner 2 slightly lighter in color than outer ones, oblanceolate, 5–10 × 2–3 mm, apex rounded, base wedged; androecium capitate, 1.5–2.5 × 2 mm; stamens 10–30; filament ca. 0.3 mm long, base-fused column 0.51 mm long; anther yellow, obovate-cuneate, ca. 0.5 mm long, apex blunt; pedicel pink, glabrous, 8–14 mm long, 0.5–0.8 mm thick. Pistillate flower: 10–15 ×10–12 mm; tepals 3, pink, glabrous; outer 2 broadly ovoid to nearly oblate, 5–7.5 × 6–8 mm; inner 1, obovate-lanceolate, 5–7 × 2–3 mm, base wedged; ovary green or pink, glabrous, 3-loculed; placentae axile, thick unilamellate; styles 3, 90 free, ca. 1–2 mm long; stigma 3–5 mm in diameter, spiraled nearly in 2 turns; pedicel pink, glabrous, 12–22 mm long, ca. 0.8 mm thick. Fruit: stalk pink, glabrous, 12–23 mm long, 0.6–1 mm thick; capsule pink or greenish pink, glabrous, ellipsoid, ca. 7–9 × 5–8 mm, unequally 3-winged, wings pink, larger one asymmetrically triangular, 6–12 × 10–15 mm, smaller 2 narrowly lunar, 1–5 × 9–13 mm.
contributor: Tian D.K., Wei H., Huang C., Wu L., Chen Z., Gou Z., Sun X., Wang S., Gao Q., Li X.
bibliographic_Citation: Tian D.K., Wei H., Huang C., Wu L., Chen Z., Gou Z., Sun X., Wang S., Gao Q., Li X. 2024, Two new species of Begoniaceae from China mainland , Taiwania. Vol.69(1) , pp.89-98.

description: Herb evergreen, 30–60 cm tall; rhizome creeping or nearly so, 1–4 cm long, 3–10 mm thick; aerial stems erect or suberect, green, few branched, internodes 1–11 cm long, 5–12 mm thick, densely white or pink pilose, hairs 5–7 mm long, nodes slightly dilated. Stipule persistent, pale green, papery, obliquely triangular, 7–12 × 5–8 mm, abaxially covered with densely whitish pilosity less than 3 mm long; margin hairy; apex acuminate, abaxially ridged; arista 5–7 mm long, densely fimbriate; hairs to 4 mm long. Leaves: 4–10; petiole green, 4–22 cm long, 2–5 mm thick, adaxially grooved, unspotted, densely greyish-white or pink villous, 6 mm long; blade obliquely ovate, 7–27 × 4–17 cm; adaxial surface densely pink or greyish-white and base-enlarged pilose, interveinal area light green, veinal area dark green; abaxial surface green and purplish red, densely red or greyish-white pilose, hairs 1–3 mm long and longer on main veins; venation palmate–pinnate, veins 6 (7), adaxially impressed, abaxially raised; apex acuminate to short caudate; margins serrate and ciliate, occasionally coarsely toothed; base obliquely cordate; acutely angled to nearly overlapped. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, 6–12 cm long, peduncle hairy, 4.5–7 cm long, 2.5–3.5 mm thick; flowers 5–7, rarely 3 per inflorescence. Bract persistent, acutely triangular, light green, papery when dried, 10–12 × 4–6 mm; bracteoles 4–10 × 2–6 mm, covered with greyish-white pilosity (3 mm long), margin ciliate, apex often acuminate. Staminate flower: 4.7–5.3 × 3.7–4.2 cm; tepals 4; outer 2, large, white, ovate to cordate, 2.4–2.9 × 2.4–3 cm, center thicker and adaxially slightly concave, bilateral bases decurrent ca. 5 mm, apex obtuse, longitudinal veins clear; abaxially sparsely greyish-white pilose, hairs ca. 2.5 mm long; inner 2, smaller, white, nearly obovate-lanceolate, 1.7–2 × 1–1.6 cm, margin slightly turnover, central part abaxially sparsely greyish-white pilose, apex obtuse, margin sparsely white ciliate, cilia ca. 1 mm long; androecium nearly capitate, symmetric, 6–8 × 8–10 mm, apically loosely arranged, stamens (67–)84–182; filament ca. 1 mm long, base slightly connate; anther yellow, nearly short cuneate, 0.8–1.5 mm long, up to 1 mm wide, apex clearly retuse; pedicel white, 3.5–4.5 cm long, 2–3 mm thick, densely covered with greyish-white pilosity (ca. 2 mm long). Pistillate flower: occasionally open prior to staminate flower, subsquare or oblong in shape, 4–5 × 34.4 cm; tepals 5, white; outer 4, larger, outside-in gradually smaller, ovate or ovate–cordate, 1.9–2.6 × 1.7– 2.1 cm, apex obtuse or acute; abaxially greyish white pilose, hairs more in middle part, ca. 3 mm long; adaxially longitudinal veins relatively obvious, dark; inner 1, significantly smaller, obovate or obovate-lanceolate, 1.51.8 × 1–1.2 cm, glabrous, apex obtuse or acute; styles + stigmas 4–5 mm long; stigmas 2, rarely 3, well developed, 7 × 5 mm in diameter, U–shaped, twisted nearly 3 turns; ovary white, densely covered with greyish white pilosity (3 mm long), incomplete 3-locular, upper 1 (broadestwinged side) smaller or degenerated; placentation axile, bilamellate; pedicel white, 2–2.1 cm long, 1.2–1.8 mm thick, with greyish white pilosity. Fruit capsule, suborbicular, ca. 10 × 10 mm, unequally 3–winged; abaxial wing large, auricular, concave, ca. 10 × 10 mm; lateral wings smaller, falcate, 2–3 × ca. 10 mm.
contributor: Tian D.K., Wei H., Huang C., Wu L., Chen Z., Gou Z., Sun X., Wang S., Gao Q., Li X.
bibliographic_Citation: Tian D.K., Wei H., Huang C., Wu L., Chen Z., Gou Z., Sun X., Wang S., Gao Q., Li X. 2024, Two new species of Begoniaceae from China mainland , Taiwania. Vol.69(1) , pp.89-98.

description: Herb monoecious, perennial, rhizomatous, 5–15 cm tall. Rhizome creeping, 5–20 cm or longer, unbranched to few branched, green to pale brown, internodes 5–8 mm long, 3–15 mm thick. Stipules persistent, green to red, nearly glabrous, long triangular, 5–8 mm × 4–7 mm, apex acuminate. Leaves simple, alternate, basal, leaf blade broad ovate, (2.6–)6–12(–24) cm × (1.9–)2.8–12(–17.5) cm, decurrent part 0.2–5.5 cm long, papery, asymmetric, adaxially green to deep brownish red, usually adorned with white to light green radial patches between veins, densely papillose-hispid, abaxially light green to deep red, densely green to red setulose, main veins 5–7, reticulate, margin serrate, base slightly to nearly overlapped, apex acuminate. Petiole green to brownish red, (1.7–)5–12(–22) cm long, 1.5–6 mm thick, ungrooved, densely gray-white villous, hairs 1–5 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, 1–8, dichasial cymes arising from rhizome, 2.5–20 cm long, branched 2–3 times, peduncle light green to reddish brown, cylindrical, 1.5–15 cm long, 1–2.5 mm thick, glabrous to sparsely villous, flowers 3–30 per inflorescence. Bracts persistent or caduceus, ellipsoid to ovate, light green, abaxially pubescent or glabrous, margin sparsely pubescent, lower bracts 2–5 mm × 1–4 mm, upper ones 1–3 mm × 0.4–2.5 mm. Staminate flower pedicel glabrous to sparsely pubescent, 8–35.5 mm long, 0.5–1 mm thick, flower size 16.5–33.5 mm × 13.2–29 mm; tepals 4 (rarely 6), white to pink, entire, outer 2 broad ovate to elliptic, 8.5–16 mm × 7.5–15.8 mm, abaxially sparsely pubescent or glabrous, inner 2 oblong to oblanceolate, glabrous, 6.515 mm × 2.5–9 mm; androecium bilaterally symmetric, upward curved, 1.8–3.5 mm × 2–5 mm, stamens 11–21(32), filaments yellow, 1–3 mm long, anthers yellow, cuneiform, 0.5–2 mm long, 0.5–0.8 mm wide, apex slightly concave. Pistillate flower pedicel glabrous to sparsely pubescent, 5–12.5 mm long, 0.5–0.8 mm thick, flower size 20.5–30 mm × 11–19 mm, tepals 3 (rarely 2 or 4), white to pink, entire, outer 2 elliptic to nearly round, 10–15 mm × 9–15.5 mm, glabrous, inner 1 (rarely 2 or absent), glabrous, oblong to cuneiform, 5–10.5 mm × 25 mm; style 3, yellow, connate base 0.5–1.6 mm long, free part 2.5–3.5 mm long, stigmatic band spiraled. Fruit nearly glabrous, 8.5–10.5 mm × 6.5–9 mm, 3winged, abaxial wing broad crescent–shaped, 2.7–4.2 mm × 6.7–8.4 mm; lateral wings equal, narrowly crescent–shaped, 2–3 mm × 6.5–8 mm. Seeds numerous, brown, elliptic.

description: Description: perennial evergreen herb, monoecious, 20–35 cm tall. Rhizome stout and creeping, 10–15 cm long and 15–25 mm in diameter, internodes obvious and crowded. Stipules reddish-brown, ovate-triangular, 8–13 × 9–15 mm, pilose. Leaves all basal, petiole reddishbrown, 8–12 cm long, densely pilose with pale green lenticles; blade asymmetric, widely ovate, 19–20 × 12–14 cm; apex caudate, base oblique-cordate; margin subentire; venation palmate with 6–9 primary veins, adaxially slightly concave, abaxially convex; leaf blade fleshy and relatively flat, adaxially blackish-green along main veins, randomly silver white between the veins, sparsely puberulous, abaxially purplish-red and densely pilose along main veins, pale green and subgrabrous between the veins. Inflorescences arising directly from rhizome; dichasial cymes branching two or three times, peduncle 13–18 cm long, glabrous; flowers unisexual, 10–12 flowers per inflorescence; bracts membranous, widely ovate to subcircular, pinkish-yellow, 4–10 × 3–8 mm, margin puberulous. Staminate flower: pedicels pale green, 20–23 mm long, glabrous; tepals 4, outer 2 whitish-pink, widely ovate to circular, margin entire, 2023 × 16–26 mm, adaxially glabrous, abaxially redly pilose; inner 2 pinkish-white, lanceolate, margin entire, 15–18 × 7–8 mm, glabrous; androecium zygomorphic, 5.6 × 7.5 mm; stamens numerous, 5.0 mm long, filaments fused at base, anthers golden yellow, clavate, base cuneate, apex retuse. Pistillate flower: pedicels pink, 1320 mm long, glabrous; tepals 3, whitish-pink, outer 2 widely ovate to subcircular, margin entire, 16–18 × 1516 mm, adaxially glabrous, abaxially sparsely pilose or glabrous; inner 1 obovate, 10–12 × 5–6 mm, glabrous; ovary pink, trigonous-ellipsoid, 11–18 × 4.6–8 mm (wings excluded), sparsely redly pilose; 1-lobuled, placentation parietal; placentae 3, each 2-branched; styles 3, fused at base, golden yellow, 3.8–5 mm long, stigma spirally U-shaped twisted. Capsule nodding, trigonousellipsoid, 18–20 × 5–6 mm (wings excluded), pinkishgreen, glabrous, unequally 3-winged, lateral wings 2, crescent-shaped, 14–16 × 2–3 mm, abaxial wing semilune-shaped, 18–20 × 7–9 mm.

description: Herbaceous, lithophytic, rhizomatous, perennial, monoecious. Stipules per-sistent, triangular 11.5–13.5 × 6–8 mm, reddish, adaxi-ally glabrescent, abaxially glabrous, herbaceous, strongly keeled with reddish brown hairs fused at the keel, mar-gin slightly revolute, apex aristate (3.5 mm long). description: Monoecious, perennial herb. Stem stands 1.3 m. tall, green to brownish, glabrous, erect, 7–8 mm in diameter, internodes 9–12 cm.
